children: AMMAN — The Greater Amman Municipality (GAM) and Barcelona City Council on Monday signed a memorandum of understanding to bolster partnership in municipal affairs, focusing on digital transformation, smart urban solutions, water management and sustainability.

The agreement was signed by Head of GAM Committee Ahmad Malkawi and Mayor of Barcelona Jaume Collboni, in the presence of Spanish Ambassador to Jordan José Luis Cuerdo and officials from both sides, according to Al Mamlaka TV.
Malkawi said that the MoU reflects the “depth” of ties between Jordan and Spain, underscoring a commitment to addressing shared challenges and advancing towards a more sustainable urban future.

He added that the collaboration covers urban planning, public space management, smart water distribution, accessibility and community engagement, noting that the MoU serves as a “launch pad” to translate joint initiatives into tangible projects.

Second Deputy Mayor of Barcelona Maria Eugènia Gay said that the agreement reinforces a relationship built on mutual trust and knowledge exchange, pointing to previous joint work in urban resilience, sustainability and local policy innovation.
Under the deal, both sides will cooperate on digital strategies and green space management, alongside the Green Amman Plan, rainwater harvesting and flood risk reduction.

The agreement also includes collaboration under GAM's 2027-2031 strategic plan, the exchange of expertise on vulnerable and low-income groups, as well as cultural, sports and educational programmes targeting youth and women, in addition to regional initiatives with other cities.
